name: Lurking: The Price of Desire, Could Be Your Life.
source:
You enter into the world of Jackson Morin, a career driven architect who has put romance and finding love on the back-burner in favour of pursuing his career, building his portfolio and making a name for himself. 

Like most things however, that changes as he soon realizes that his self-imposed isolation with the exception of the occasional hook-up isn't fulfilling him anymore and only adding to his state of loneliness. 

If embarking on the journey in pursuit of finding love wasn't precarious enough, there's also a murderer Lurking in the shadows of your once peaceful town. 

How far are you willing to go to uncover the identity of the murderer in order to protect and save the ones you love?

[From [url=https://lurking-vn.itch.io/lurking]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你进入了杰克逊·莫林（Jackson Morin）的世界，他是一位以事业为导向的建筑师，他把浪漫和寻找爱情放在次要位置，转而追求自己的事业、建立自己的作品集并为自己赢得声誉。

然而，就像大多数事情一样，这种情况发生了变化，因为他很快意识到，除了偶尔的勾搭之外，他自我强加的孤立已经不再让他满足，只会加剧他的孤独状态。

如果踏上寻找爱情的旅程还不够危险的话，那么在你曾经平静的小镇的阴影下还潜伏着一名凶手。

为了保护和拯救你所爱的人，你愿意走多远去揭露凶手的身份？

[来自[url=https://lurking-vn.itch.io/lurking]Itch.io[/url]]
